# Asksvin tail

Type: Material | Internal ID: AsksvinMeat | Source: Asksvin, , Asksvin Hatchling | Usage: Food preparation table, ,, Iron cooking station | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Asksvin tail is a food dropped by Asksvin. It can be cooked using an Iron cooking station over a lit Campfire to obtain a Cooked asksvin tail, or Coal if overcooked.

## Availability

• Creature: Asksvin | 0 Star: 2 | 1 Star: 4 | 2 Star: 8

#### For Asksvin tail

• Cooked asksvin tail
• Coal, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long
• Fiery svinstew
• Mashed meat
• Uncooked piquant pie

#### For Cooked asksvin tail

• Ashlands gourmet bowl
Cooked asksvin tail cannot be used to craft recipes using Asksvin tail as ingredient.

Categorias: Materials, Food
